description: Verify a gate access attempt. Three shapes: (a) {nonce, solution} verifies a PoW solve and returns a 5-min token; (b) {request_invoice: true} mints a fresh L402 bolt11 invoice for the Lightning-skip tier; (c) {payment_hash} polls for L402 payment and returns the token once paid. Returns {token, method, content} on success.

payment_hash.description: Payment hash returned by request_invoice; poll until paid

request_invoice.description: Set true to mint an L402 invoice instead of solving the PoW

solution.description: Hex string such that SHA-256(nonce+solution) has required leading zeros

name: l402_gate_verify
